Case: FIXTURE-FY24
Section: Item 1A. Risk Factors

[PDF_PAGE 10 | PRINTED_PAGE 8]
[PARAGRAPH FIXTURE-FY24-P001]
The company may face demand volatility that could reduce revenue and margins.

[PARAGRAPH FIXTURE-FY24-P002]
The company relies on a third-party supplier, and a disruption could delay production.

[PDF_PAGE 11 | PRINTED_PAGE 9]
[PARAGRAPH FIXTURE-FY24-P003]
Changes in privacy regulation could increase compliance costs and limit product features.
